summary: American software engineer and blogger Curtis Yarvin, writing as Mencius Moldbug from 2007, built an anti-democratic case for CEO-style monarchy laced with race science that shaped the alt-right and Peter Thiel's political circle, including J.D. Vance.

evidence.note: born around Brooklyn in 1973; host flags the exact birth date as unverified
online from 1989 on Usenet; the 1993 Eternal September framed as root of his hatred of democracy
reading of Rothbard, Carlyle and Hoppe leads him to absolute one-man rule
launches the Moldbug blog in 2007; used as main_span start
followers' fixation on human biodiversity and IQ as a genetic right to rule
his 2011 blog response to the Breivik massacre treats terror as legitimate if it works
Vance and Blake Masters as followers who repeat his ideas and attend the same events
RAGE idea linked to Trump's 2020 federal worker reclassification and 2025 plans
2008 blog post questioning whether Obama attended Columbia, compared to birtherism
his eulogy for Ian Smith and praise of Rhodesia and Camp of the Saints
2013-14 neoreaction press coverage and 2014 unmasking while at Thiel-backed Tlon
2016 election night at Thiel's house and leaked 2017 emails with Yiannopoulos

notes: Lifetime rule sets covered_span 1973-2024 (alive at release). Monarchy-empire considered for his CEO-monarch theory but left out: the story is about a modern ideologue, not monarchy as an institution. Peter Thiel recurs throughout as funder but has no segment of his own, so he is a keyword. Childhood stints in Cyprus and the Dominican Republic are brief and not added to setting. Breivik and birther material are short segments, not themes.
